calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: current user-reviewed bamboo-grove postcard, the edit target. Continue editing this version, keeping its two character identities and restrained hand-painted style.

Correct TWO problems: the caterpillar is too tiny and camouflaged; the right half is too empty. Rebalance the scene so the story is immediately readable at postcard size.

COMPOSITION:
- Keep the toad and his indigo flower satchel at their present left-foreground bamboo-root position, same size/body/proportions. His gaze goes toward the action on the right.
- MOVE the one existing yellow JOJO away from above the toad to the RIGHT middle-foreground, at the edge of a small bamboo clump beside the stone path. Remove the old left Jojo completely and naturally restore foliage there; never duplicate him.
- Place Jojo around 72% image width, with his feet around 75% image height. Bring him closer in perspective so his full height is about 25–27% of the picture, similar visual weight to the foreground toad but not a huge portrait. His feet firmly touch a visible earthy patch beside the path. The little red cape and lifted hands now occupy the formerly empty right side.
- Extend a few broad bamboo stems/leaf clusters along the far right edge behind Jojo, with a small low group of leaves at the bottom-right, keeping the house still visible above. Let the stone path curve between the characters into the distance. Reduce the large blank expanse of road; do not fill it with scattered objects or additional characters.
- Preserve recognizable house, distant mountains, sky, drainage stream and major foreground bamboo. Keep balanced foreground/midground/background and enough quiet space.

MAKE THE PIG-CATERPILLAR CLEAR:
Jojo leans slightly forward, looking intently at ONE plump GREEN CATERPILLAR he has just gently caught on a leaf. His rounded yellow hands cup and lift a single leaf at chest height. Put the caterpillar's complete SIDE SILHOUETTE against his pale yellow palm/body, not against green foliage. Do not hide it inside fingers or under leaves.
At 1536x1024, caterpillar should be about 75–90 pixels long and 22–28 pixels thick (roughly HALF Jojo's face width), approximately 2.5–3 times longer than thick. This small illustrative exaggeration is deliberate for postcard readability: visibly larger than the previous indistinct speck, still not a giant pet. Use a gently curved short thick body with 5–6 clearly separated rounded segments, a slightly smaller plain head, and a few tiny prolegs; fresh light green, deep olive lower contour and one broad soft shadow. No smile, human face, large eyes, pig nose, snail shell, fuzz, horns or fantasy details. It is a natural fleshy green larva, the Sichuan colloquial 猪儿虫. It MUST read as a caterpillar without zooming.

IDENTITY AND STYLE:
Exactly one toad and one Jojo. Jojo remains yellow continuous capsule head/body, small two-lobed tuft, brown white-rimmed eyes, tiny orange beak, short orange legs, rounded yellow wing-hands with no human fingers, red-orange cape and THREE rounded front bow lobes. Toad remains ochre-olive, cream belly, amber eyes, orange glands and same body silhouette. They do not talk or jointly catch the insect; toad only watches.
Same natural daylight, fresh neutral colors, low-mottling gouache and dark-brown organic contours. Preserve broad coherent colors and a few painterly marks; do NOT add speckled pavement, bark scratches, fragmented leafy shadows, global grain, red/yellow tint, blur, flat vector finish or shiny3D.
One full-bleed landscape 1536x1024, 3:2. No text, labels, inset closeup, frame, UI, extra props or new story events.

calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: the newly balanced bamboo postcard with a clear green caterpillar on the right. Keep the entire landscape and toad unchanged. Make ONE targeted correction: JOJO is too large and dominant for a secondary cameo.

Reduce JOJO's complete body height by approximately 28%, from the current roughly 370 pixels to about 265 pixels in this 1536x1024 canvas. Scale the WHOLE character proportionally, including head, cape, face, arms and short feet; do NOT only shrink his head or stretch his legs. Keep him on the SAME right-side earthy ground, with the soles at about y=755 and horizontal center around x=1205; his top should now be around y=490 rather than y=395. Fill the narrow area vacated around him with the existing continuous bamboo/foliage, not new objects. He must be similar projected height to the seated toad on the left, not a huge foreground mascot.

Maintain the raised leaf and catching/holding pose. Keep ONE green plump caterpillar clearly readable, approximately 75–85px long and 22–25px thick, resting in SIDE VIEW across the leaf above his cupped pale-yellow hands. Do not let it become an indistinct green speck again. Distinct short rounded body segments, small plain head and tiny prolegs; no cartoon smile, giant eyes, pig nose or added limbs. Maintain contrast with pale-yellow hands/body and the caterpillar's olive contour.
Preserve Jojo's yellow capsule proportions, three-lobed red bow, red-orange cape, small beak, short orange legs, eyes and tuft. No new characters or duplicate Jojo.
Everything else locked: left toad and blue satchel; stone path and stream; right framing bamboo; house, mountain, sky; fresh neutral colors and low-mottling gouache brushwork. No new texture, blur, color filter, text, diagram or frame. Return same complete 1536x1024 landscape.
calls.inspection: 叫叫已收小，位于右侧竹丛前，叶上绿虫的完整分节轮廓可见；左侧保留癞疙宝与花包，未重复角色。

visual: 左前景疙宝与靛蓝花包留在竹根旁，朝右侧旁观；叫叫移到右侧中前景的竹丛边，脚踩实地，双手将叶上的短胖分节绿虫托在浅黄色身体前，完整虫体轮廓清楚；右侧竹叶收拢空路，保留石板弯路、屋舍和远山，无对白或共同捕虫。

storyUnchanged.title: 竹林里，抓猪儿虫
storyUnchanged.text: 竹叶沙沙响，疙宝在竹根边歇脚，看见叫叫正弯着身子抓猪儿虫。胖乎乎的绿虫趴在叶上，叫叫小心一拢，连着叶子托了起来。疙宝在凉荫里望着，没有凑过去打扰。
storyUnchanged.note: 猪儿虫是四川话里对青虫的俗称，此处画成肉乎乎的绿色幼虫，不指定具体物种。这段竹林偶遇为虚构见闻，不新增捕虫玩法或收藏品。

inspection.result: 620px宽静态缩略预览中，叶上绿虫及分节轮廓可辨，左右角色分布更均衡，右侧不再是大片空路。不是浏览器/游戏或正式HTTPS验收。

processing: 项目成品为模型输出的逐字节副本，无程序重绘/滤镜/裁切/压缩。仅额外在临时目录缩小到620px做辨识度检查，不用检查图替代成品。两次调用的尺寸/缩小百分比是提示目标，不宣称精确像素实现。
scope: 仅第一张插画和图文预览映射/说明调整，四则故事正文、其他三张图与游戏运行文件不变；保留原底图及v2，不清理其他文件。无构建/试玩、提交/推送、发布或存档/Token操作。
